what: 199 questions an independent reviewer of the first 1.24.7 (2026-11-06) wrote to try the filled recipes on: the bench's sums asked another way, in another unit, with a step more, or asking another thing of the same numbers. truth is the reviewer's answer in the unit asked (null: one number cannot answer it). The first 1.24.7 filled 160 of them, 86 wrongly. now is what Lantern does with each: filled (with its line), not filled (the recipe goes to the model with its blanks, as on 1.24.6), or more than one recipe (never filled).
